summary: The order calendar for team kits: allow 25–30 days, order before mid-August for a September start, and work backwards from a fixed tournament date.
content:
Quick answer

Allow 25–30 days from order to delivery. For a mid-September season start, order before mid-August and lock the design in June–July. For a fixed tournament date, order at least five weeks ahead. No minimum order.

The season calendar, working backwards

WhenWhat to do
JuneLock colours, crest and design; line up a sponsor
JulyCollect sizes; validate the mock-up
Mid-AugustPlace the order (latest, for a September start)
SeptemberKit delivered before kick-off

Why 25–30 days

That window covers design validation, dye-sublimation production and delivery. Rushing it risks a mid-season delivery; starting early means you validate calmly and collect sizes without chasing. Routes and prices are in the complete guide.

Ordering mid-season or for a one-off

Joining a winter league, replacing a damaged set, or kitting a one-off tournament? The same 25–30 day window applies — just work back from your date. For events, see tournament kits.

Frequently asked questions

How long does a custom kit take?

Around 25–30 days from confirmed order to delivery, including production. Add a day or two to validate the design first.

When should we order for a September start?

Before mid-August at the latest, and ideally lock the design in June–July so you order with sizes already collected.

Can you do it faster for a tournament?

Work back from the date and order at least five weeks ahead. Get in touch early and we’ll confirm what’s possible.
